turns.question: What share of total non-cancelled order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026 came from the top three customers by revenue, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of revenue from the top customers, and I cannot compute the percentage myself; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur): from 17 August to 2 October 2026 the top three customers by revenue were customer 10 with EUR 2,356.00, customer 2 with EUR 2,331.00 and customer 1 with EUR 2,164.95, against total revenue of EUR 19,506.59 for the same days. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
